open_app.description: Launch an installed application by name

close_app.description: Close a running application by name

force.description: Force close if not responding (default false)

focus_window.description: Bring a window to the foreground by title or process name

title.description: Window title to match (partial match ok)

minimize_window.description: Minimize a window by title or process name

maximize_window.description: Maximize a window by title or process name, or restore it if already maximized

get_active_window.description: Get the title and process name of the currently focused window

get_window_bounds.description: Get the position and size of a window by title. Returns left, top, width, height for region cropping.

title.description: Window title to match (partial match ok)

_confirmed.description: Must be set to True after getting explicit user confirmation
Must be set to True after getting explicit user confirmation

screenshot.description: Capture a screenshot of the primary monitor or a region

region.description: Optional crop: {left, top, width, height}. Omit for full screen.

read_screen.description: Extract visible text from the screen via OCR

region.description: Optional crop: {left, top, width, height}. Omit for full screen.

click.description: Click at screen coordinates or on a UI element

move_mouse.description: Move the mouse cursor to screen coordinates

duration.description: Duration of the movement in seconds (default 0.2)

drag.description: Drag the mouse from one point to another (click-hold-move-release)

duration.description: Duration of the drag in seconds (default 0.3)

type_text.description: Type text into the currently focused window

clicks.description: Number of scroll ticks. Negative = up, positive = down (default -3)

set_volume.description: Set the system speaker volume level

list_running_apps.description: List all running applications with window titles and process names

get_process_info.description: Get detailed information about running processes

kill_process.description: Terminate a running process by name or PID

pid.description: Process ID to kill (alternative to name)

force.description: Force kill if not responding (default true)

get_system_stats.description: Report CPU, RAM, disk, and battery level/status via system APIs. Use this for battery percentage queries — do NOT use screenshot or read_screen for battery info.

search_files.description: Search for files and folders by name pattern

open_file.description: Open a file with its default application

read_file.description: Read the contents of a text file

write_file.description: Create or overwrite a text file

delete_file.description: Delete a file or empty folder permanently

path.description: Full path to the file or folder

move_file.description: Move or rename a file or folder

run_python.description: Execute Python code only (not PowerShell). Use for quick calculations, data transforms, or small scripts. For PowerShell or background tasks, use execute_code instead.

detect_ui_elements.description: Detect UI elements on screen via OCR. Returns bounding boxes and center_x/center_y for each element — pass center_x/center_y directly to click(). Use vision_query for images/icons.

text.description: Optional text to filter results — only returns elements containing this string

element_type.description: Element type filter (default: all). 'button' uses heuristics (short/caps text). 'tab' detects tab-like elements near top of screen. OCR-based — use vision_query for images/icons.

region.description: Optional screen region: {left, top, width, height}

min_confidence.description: Minimum OCR confidence 0-100 (default 50). Raise to reduce noise.

read_clipboard.description: Read the current text content of the Windows clipboard

write_clipboard.description: Write text to the Windows clipboard so the user can paste it anywhere

notify.description: Send a Windows desktop toast notification. Use proactively when a long task finishes, something critical is detected, or a reminder fires — even if the user isn't looking at the terminal.

delegate_to_subagent.description: Delegate a complex or specialized task to a focused sub-agent. Sub-agents run their own tool loop and report results back to Jarvis. Use this when a task has multiple steps that belong to one domain. Available agents: 'research' (web search, fetch pages), 'file' (read/write/search files), 'system' (processes, apps, hardware), 'perception' (screen analysis, vision, OCR), 'interaction' (mouse, keyboard, clicks, typing), 'memory' (store/retrieve/search preferences and past context).

agent.description: Sub-agent to delegate to. Omit to auto-route based on the goal.

goal.description: Clear description of what the sub-agent should accomplish.

context.description: Optional supporting data for the sub-agent. Examples: {query, max_results, fetch_top_n} for research; {action, path, pattern} for file; {action, app_name, level} for system; {question, region} for perception; {actions, targets} for interaction; {operation, key, value} for memory.

timeout.description: Max seconds the sub-agent may run (default 120).

web_search.description: Search the web and return results with snippets and URLs

open_url.description: Open a URL in the default web browser

fetch_page.description: Fetch and return the text content of a webpage

store_memory.description: Save a fact or preference to long-term memory

retrieve_memory.description: Retrieve a fact or preference from long-term memory by key

forget_memory.description: Delete a key from long-term memory

search_memory.description: Full-text search across episodic history and stored facts

send_message.description: Send a message via email or Telegram

speak.description: Speak text aloud through the speakers

update_memory.description: Update an existing stored memory value by key

summarize_session.description: Get a summary of recent session activity and stored memories

get_battery.description: Get battery percentage, charging status, and estimated time remaining. Use this for any battery query.

list_installed_apps.description: Search installed apps by name. Use this to discover installed software. Note: open_app can launch many apps by name alone without calling this first.

query.description: Optional search term to filter apps

set_brightness.description: Set screen brightness level. Uses WMI to adjust monitor brightness.

minimize_all_except.description: Minimize all open windows except the specified one. Use press_keys('win+d')+focus_window instead if you just need the desktop.

exclude_titles.description: Window titles or process names to leave open (e.g. ['AnyDesk', 'Chrome'])

vision_query.description: Capture the screen and ask gemma3:27b a visual question about what it shows. Use this when you need to read UI text, detect dialogs, find element positions, or describe visual content.

question.description: Specific question about what is on screen

region.description: Optional crop: {left, top, width, height}. Omit for full screen.

path.description: Full path for the new file

schedule.description: Schedule, cancel, or list timed/recurring tasks. Actions: add (requires command + when), cancel (requires task_id), list.

when.description: Schedule expression: 'in 10 minutes', 'at 09:00', 'every day at 07:30', 'on Monday at 09:00'

task_id.description: Task ID to cancel (required for cancel)

listen.description: Listen for a spoken response from the user. Optionally speak a prompt first. Returns transcribed text.

prompt.description: Optional text to speak before listening

speak_prompt.description: Speak the prompt via TTS (default true)

time_calendar.description: Get current time/date or manage calendar events. Actions: get_time, get_events (days), create_event (subject, start), delete_event (subject, date). Supports Outlook and ICS backends.

start.description: Start datetime ISO string (required for create)

days.description: Days ahead to query (default 7, used with get_events)

data_analysis.description: Analyze structured data using pandas. Input data as CSV text, get summary statistics and visualizations.

data.description: CSV data or Python expression to analyze

operations.description: Operations to perform: describe, head, correlation, plot, custom

execute_code.description: Execute Python or PowerShell code. Supports background tasks, timeout, and sandboxed execution with import guard. Use for: running scripts, automation, system queries, installing packages. For Python-only quick tasks, prefer run_python.

download_file.description: Download a file from a URL to a local path

wait.description: Pause execution or wait for a condition. Use 'condition' + 'target' to wait for events: process_running, process_gone, window_visible, text_visible, cpu_idle. Falls back to blind sleep if no condition given.

ms.description: Fallback milliseconds to sleep (default 1000). Only used when no condition specified.

condition.description: Event to wait for. Polls until condition is met or timeout.

target.description: Target for the condition: process name, window title, or CPU threshold (0-100).

timeout_ms.description: Max time to wait for the condition (defaults to 2x ms).
